selection: Maximum development mean macro F1 over the three single-label heads; test once after selection. Fixed affix threshold 0.5.
split: Whole suras by sha256(nabt-morph-v1:SURA) first 8 hex digits modulo 10: 0 test, 1 dev, others train. All cross-sura duplicate verses after removing combining marks are quarantined before splitting. Original word bytes are unchanged.
supervision: Single-stem fine morphological tag; explicit معرب/مبني annotation; raw case/mood field; explicit prefix/suffix tag set. No syntax/semantics labels. Multiple stems/annotation IDs, missing visible vowel marks, excessive character length and narrow book-constraint conflicts retain their context but receive no supervised labels.
authority: Predictions are unverified morphology proposals. No classifier score licenses a reading, statement or rule.
claims: Expanded Quranic morphological training only. Not general Arabic completeness, full-book acquisition, semantic/world truth, or an LLM.
